question: The incident ray, the ray perpendicular to the point of incidence, and the reflected ray all lie________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** in the same plane.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• According to the **first law of the reflection** the incident ray, the reflected ray, and the normal at the point of incidence, **lie in the same plane.**
 
• The normal is perpendicular to the plane of reflection.
 
• The **angle of incidence ∠ i is equal to the angle of reflection ∠ r.**
